name.en: SDS-Plus Masonry Drill Bit Set for Rotary Hammers, Carbide-Tipped for Concrete and Brick, 4 or 6 Pieces
name.pt-BR: Jogo de Brocas SDS-Plus para Martelete, com Ponta de Metal Duro para Concreto e Tijolo, 4 ou 6 Peças

description.en: Carbide-tipped masonry bits with a grooved SDS-plus shank that locks into a rotary hammer for fast holes in concrete and brick. They need an SDS-plus tool and do not fit a drill or drill driver with a regular chuck, of any size.
description.pt-BR: Brocas de metal duro com haste SDS-plus ranhurada, que trava no martelete para furar concreto e tijolo com rapidez. Exigem ferramenta SDS-plus e não servem em furadeira ou parafusadeira com mandril comum, de nenhum tamanho.
